title: Press Conference: Ringo Starr and Peter Sellers in Los Angeles | 1970
content:
Ringo Starr and Peter Sellers held a press conference on 28 January 1970 to promote their film The Magic Christian.

The event took place at the Beverly Hills Hotel in Los Angeles.

The majority of the questions were aimed at Starr and The Beatles. He explained that he did not foresee any of the group attending the US premiere of Let It Be, not least due to visa issues following John Lennon and George Harrison’s drugs busts.

Page last updated: 16 February 2026
